inventory.reason: Museum advertising proves aquatic play and slides but does not reliably identify individual built facilities. No named slides, ride count, wave-pool technology, restaurants, shops, manufacturers or precise item positions invented. Current garden play equipment is not historical park inventory.
inventory.millDecision: SyAGE guide confirms former abbey mill site; contributor Didier Simonnet says old mill building integrated into Triton. Public visitor use as a distinct attraction/service remains unproved, so no arbitrary item created.
